_note: Words Colin spells his own way that are NOT errors. Without this allowlist the misspelling-rate marker would count his British-variant spellings as mistakes, inflating the rate and — worse — teaching the orthography layer to 'correct' a genuine part of his voice into American spellings he does not use.
_policy: Add a word here only after confirming it appears repeatedly and deliberately. A one-off typo belongs in error-table.json (which records what he actually mistypes), not here.
